summary: This area covers SDBASE's HTTP service (api_server/http_server), the CLI, every desktop_* workflow, managed-media staging (media.py), the endpoint agent and offline WAV renderer, and the mAirList/RadioBOSS/LibreTime/Rekordbox adapters. None of it imports on Windows today: the package imports fcntl when it loads (storage.py, endpoint_journal.py, which cli.py imports at top level), and workflow_api imports every module up front. Linux-specific code found: flock, os.getuid/st_uid and 0600/0700 mode checks, O_NOFOLLOW/O_DIRECTORY/O_NONBLOCK/dir_fd opens, a /proc/self/fd reopen (desktop_media.py:624), os.statvfs (capacity_monitor), directory fsync through os.open(dir), os.link publication, stopping by SIGTERM/SIGINT, link checks that only catch symlinks (junctions slip through), and '/'-rooted path validators that use the host's os.path and also run on persisted records (validate_library runs at every commit and in the integrity scrub). The most dangerous Windows-only hazard is that raw os.open() returns text-mode CRT file descriptors. Without anyone noticing, that corrupts the exact bytes of reviewed CSV/M3U8 sources, the endpoint journal, WAV reads and credential files. Every data descriptor must come from the shim with O_BINARY. The recommended design is a Windows-only sdbase/_platform.py (ctypes) that matches the C platform contract: binary, non-inheritable, share-delete opens with a no-follow post-check; open_beneath in the style of openat (NtCreateFile); rename and unlink with POSIX semantics and a 2000 ms retry on sharing violations; no directory fsync; LockFileEx at 0x4000000000000000; the private SDDL with explicit owner plus owner and no-others checks; and path helpers identical to radios_path_*. BoundedHTTPServer is the base of the API, failover and replication listeners. It must drop SO_REUSEADDR (on Windows that allows a second process to bind the same port), set SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE, skip the getfqdn reverse lookup, raise the listen backlog, and treat ConnectionAbortedError as a client disconnect. Graceful shutdown moves from signals to the shared manual-reset event Local\RadioS-stop-<pid>, plus SIGINT/SIGBREAK and console close/logoff events; a process is identified by pid plus creation time. serve_forever gets a watcher thread that calls shutdown(), the service loop polls the event, and the long-running CLI loops get the event as their stop flag. Time zones need the bundled tzdata (otherwise even ZoneInfo('UTC') fails and station creation breaks). Keys must also be validated with exact case, because Windows file lookup ignores case. Path validators become host-independent: new writes require canonical Windows absolute paths under the C storage-folder rules, while POSIX values from Linux databases stay valid as plain strings. Transfer-package import sanitises every path component (device names, ADS colons, trailing dots). Credential keys, packages, backups and temp sources get ACL-based privacy: keys fail closed on FAT/exFAT, packages there proceed with a warning. The integrity-scrub child process needs the D4 interpreter flags, a cleaned environment, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, its working directory at the source root (PYTHONPATH is ignored under -E) and explicit UTF-8 decoding. USB/SD Rekordbox discovery stays in the C GUI; Python only has to accept drive roots such as E:\.
key_decisions: Windows-only shim sdbase/_platform.py (ctypes/msvcrt/_winapi, D1, no POSIX branches), imported relatively because tools import the package under an alias. It matches the cross-language contracts in core-posix-files.md §5: lock region 0x4000000000000000 length 1, private SDDL with explicit owner plus owner/no-others checks, stop event Local\RadioS-stop-<pid>, process identity = pid + creation time, source digest sorted by name bytes with an exact lowercase .py suffix.

Every read/written data descriptor goes through open_fd: O_BINARY, non-inheritable, share READ|WRITE|DELETE, no-follow post-check. Readers of managed objects use open_read so streaming or hashing never blocks replace/delete. O_APPEND keeps FILE_WRITE_DATA so the endpoint journal's ftruncate repair still works.

No directory fsync on Windows (delete those blocks). Durability = FlushFileBuffers of the file + journaled rename. replace() uses FileRenameInfoEx with POSIX semantics, falls back to FileRenameInfo, and retries sharing violations within 2000 ms. Publishing without overwrite uses MoveFileExW without REPLACE_EXISTING instead of os.link.

BoundedHTTPServer: allow_reuse_address=False, allow_reuse_port=False, SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE, bypass HTTPServer.getfqdn, request_queue_size=64, quiet handle_error for ConnectionError. Stays IPv4 on 127.0.0.1. Bind error 10048 or 10013 maps to a clear Turkish message.

Graceful stop: StopRequest (manual-reset named event + watcher thread, SIGINT/SIGBREAK in console runs, SetConsoleCtrlHandler for close/logoff/shutdown waiting on a finished event up to 4.5 s). serve() runs a watcher that calls server.shutdown(); the tools handle_request loop polls the event. Callers verify identity with an OpenProcess handle + creation time before request_stop; the service is never hard-killed on timeout.

Path validators on persisted records become host-independent (stored_path_flavour). New writes require canonical Windows absolute paths. Legacy POSIX strings from Linux databases and packages stay valid as strings only. Project-relative provenance stays in portable '/' form; absolute paths returned to C are native.

Destination and media folders for transfer packages follow the C spec 5.5 storage-folder rules (absolute, canonical, not a root, not a link or junction, realpath equal ignoring case, write probe, protected project folders joined component-wise). Every name written to disk goes through component_valid/sanitize_component (based on os.path.isreserved).

Time zones: bundled tzdata (D3) with a fail-fast check at startup; every validator uses canonical_timezone (exact-case membership in available_timezones()) so non-canonical keys such as 'Europe/istanbul' or 'UTC ' are never persisted.

Child Python processes: python_child_argv adds -E -s -B -X utf8, python_child_env strips PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, explicit encoding='utf-8'. The integrity scrub runs '-m sdbase.cli' with cwd = the source root and an absolute --db, and becomes cancellable on service stop.

media._stage_object gains a source_fd parameter that replaces the /proc/self/fd reopen. desktop_media opens staged imports with open_beneath (NtCreateFile relative to a pinned directory handle, deny-write sharing).

Privacy: private-user-keys and credential files use mkdir_private/open_fd(private=True) and fail closed on volumes without ACLs. Export packages are private where the volume supports it, otherwise they proceed with a warning (FAT/exFAT USB sticks). Transfer temp dirs and backups inside the project are private.

USB/SD Rekordbox discovery stays in the C GUI (enumerating removable drives). Python accepts drive roots (E:\) and UNC as usb_root, composes PureWindowsPath locations, and records a loss (rather than failing the whole library) for device names Windows cannot represent.
risks: Sharing violations lasting longer than the 2 s retry budget (Defender scans, backup agents, OneDrive, the C player holding objects without FILE_SHARE_DELETE) still fail replace/unlink; user-facing errors must be clear and retryable.
With SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE, rebinding right after a stop can fail while connections the old listener accepted are still closing; needs a bounded bind retry plus a test. Never fall back to SO_REUSEADDR.
If the C and Python ACL privacy definitions drift, credentials or keys get rejected; needs a cross-language interop test.
On FAT/exFAT, credential keys fail closed and packages cannot be private; the lead should confirm this UX.
Linux-origin data (POSIX provenance, recorder folders, import profiles, storage.ini inside packages) stays readable but cannot be used as Windows paths; import profiles have to be re-selected.
Deep album trees from transfer packages can exceed 260 characters when LongPathsEnabled is off; such songs are skipped with a warning.
tzdata 2026.5 in Python and Windows registry rules (via ICU) in C can disagree on future rule changes; tzdata must be updated each release, with a test comparing the two.
Idle keep-alive connections can delay stop by up to request_timeout unless socket tracking/drain is implemented.
Under DETACHED_PROCESS the service gets no console events at logoff/shutdown and the OS kills it; this relies on the journal being crash-safe.
If the engine port is late, nothing in this area imports: sdbase/__init__ pulls in storage (fcntl) and workflow_api imports every module eagerly.
cross_area_dependencies: Engine area: remove fcntl from storage.py and integrity.py (blocks importing the package and desktop_admin), provide or merge the shared _platform.py, add a stop parameter to replication_stream.follow_forever, use ProxyHandler({}) in replication_stream.build_opener (the Windows registry proxy otherwise applies), write the replication hash file with newline='\n', and settle who owns ops_scheduler.py/ops_archive.py (they still use fcntl and mode&0o077 checks).

Tools area (tools/radios_database.py, radios_database_setup.py): replace /proc identity and pidfd/SIGTERM with process_identity + request_stop (service.json stores pid + creation_ticks); spawn the service with the D3 detached flags plus -E -s -B -X utf8; add startup sweeps of stale .uploads/upload-* and .native-transfer-*; make backend_source_digest identical to runtime_version.source_digest (exact '.py', byte order); relax the python_command regex for Windows paths; fix _copy_fsync, which flushes a read-only fd; keep tools/_platform.py identical in behaviour to sdbase/_platform.py.

C platform layer (core-posix-files.md): same lock region, the same private SDDL and owner/no-others semantics, the stop event name Local\RadioS-stop-<pid>, and identical path rules (radios_path_is_absolute/normalize/component_valid/is_inside/equal) so Python and C agree on storage and transfer folders and the recorder folder.

C GUI/data client: send native, realpath'd absolute paths (destination_dir, media_root, package_path, usb_root, source_path/source_root); close staged import files before calling desktop-media/import*; enumerate removable drives (GetLogicalDrives/GetDriveTypeW) to offer Rekordbox usb_root; write returned CSV/M3U8/INI content in binary with LF; accept backslash paths in managed_path/credential_file/package_path/location.

Audio area (WASAPI backend): keep the synthetic virtual-bus ids radios_virtual_<id>, .monitor, _mic and @talk in stored routing configs (the Python validator's feedback-loop detection depends on them); map @DEFAULT_SINK@, empty and Linux Pulse device names to the default endpoint; routing_graph.c must apply the same recorder-folder absolute rule as desktop_api.

Packaging/build: runtime\python 3.14.8 with tzdata and no ._pth; CTest must run Python tests on runtime\python\python.exe, and the PYTHONPATH entries in CMakeLists.txt:916,1092 must use ';' separators (escaped); manifest stays longPathAware and the installer may enable LongPathsEnabled; recommend a Defender exclusion for <root>\data; add a firewall rule only if replication binds a LAN address.
Time zones (C side): add a cross-language test comparing Python ZoneInfo offsets with radios_time_zone_new for representative zones and transitions.
platform_api_needs: open_fd(path: str | os.PathLike, flags: int, *, nofollow: bool = False, private: bool = False, share_delete: bool = True, deny_write: bool = False) -> int — CreateFileW + msvcrt.open_osfhandle; always O_BINARY|O_NOINHERIT; os.O_* access/disposition mapping per C spec 4.3; O_APPEND keeps FILE_WRITE_DATA and sets CRT _O_APPEND; nofollow = FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT + FileAttributeTagInfo post-check (name-surrogate -> OSError(ELOOP)); private = C spec 5.2 file SDDL O:<SID>D:P(A;;FA;;;<SID>)(A;;FA;;;SY)(A;;FA;;;BA); paths >= 240 UTF-16 units use the \\?\ form.
open_read(path, *, nofollow: bool = False) -> BinaryIO — binary reader that shares READ|WRITE|DELETE.

open_beneath(directory, name: str, *, deny_write: bool = True) -> tuple[int, os.stat_result] — openat replacement: pinned directory handle (no FILE_SHARE_DELETE, must not be a link) + NtCreateFile(RootDirectory, FILE_NON_DIRECTORY_FILE|FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT); name must pass component_valid; must be a regular disk file; sharing violation -> OSError(EBUSY).
fsync(fd: int) -> None — os.fsync; no-op on a read-only handle.
replace(src, dst) -> None — FileRenameInfoEx(REPLACE_IF_EXISTS|POSIX_SEMANTICS|IGNORE_READONLY), fallback FileRenameInfo, retry winerror 5/32/33 with sleeps 5..250 ms, 2000 ms total.
rename_noreplace(src, dst) -> None — MoveFileExW(MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH) without REPLACE; destination exists -> FileExistsError.

unlink(path, *, missing_ok: bool = True) -> None — FileDispositionInfoEx(DELETE|POSIX_SEMANTICS|IGNORE_READONLY), never follows links, retry budget; unlink_quietly(path) -> bool; rmtree_quietly(path) -> bool.
stat_is_link(st: os.stat_result) -> bool (FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT and reparse tag & 0x20000000); is_link(path) -> bool; has_link_component(path) -> bool.

owned_by_current_user(path_or_fd) -> bool; is_private(path_or_fd) -> bool; make_private(path_or_fd) -> None; mkdir_private(path, *, parents: bool = False, exist_ok: bool = False) -> None — exactly C spec 5.2; volumes without FILE_PERSISTENT_ACLS -> False / OSError(ENOTSUP).

lock(fd: int, *, shared: bool = False, blocking: bool = True) -> None; unlock(fd: int) -> None — LockFileEx/UnlockFileEx, 1 byte at 0x4000000000000000; UnlockFileEx before every relock; non-blocking and already held -> BlockingIOError(EWOULDBLOCK).
disk_free(path) -> int (bytes available to the caller); dir_writable(path) -> bool (CREATE_NEW + DELETE_ON_CLOSE probe); long_paths_enabled() -> bool (RtlAreLongPathsEnabled).

is_absolute(p: str) -> bool; is_root(p: str) -> bool; normalize(p: str) -> str; is_canonical(p: str) -> bool; path_equal(a, b) -> bool (CompareStringOrdinal ignore-case, either separator); is_inside(root, p) -> bool; component_valid(name: str) -> bool (os.path.isreserved-based, max 255 UTF-16 units); sanitize_component(text: str, fallback: str, *, limit: int = 150) -> str; stored_path_flavour(value: str) -> 'windows' | 'legacy-posix' | None.

python_child_argv(*args: str) -> list[str] = [sys.executable, '-E', '-s', '-B', '-X', 'utf8', *args]; python_child_env(base: Mapping[str, str] | None = None) -> dict[str, str] (drop PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME; set PYTHONUTF8=1, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8); CHILD_CREATIONFLAGS = subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW.

process_identity(pid: int) -> tuple[int, int] | None — (pid, creation time in 100 ns ticks since 1601) of a running process via OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION|SYNCHRONIZE), WaitForSingleObject(h, 0), GetProcessTimes.

stop_event_name(pid: int | None = None) -> str ('Local\\RadioS-stop-<pid>'); class StopRequest (attributes event: threading.Event and finished: threading.Event; install() -> StopRequest; close(); usable as a context manager) — CreateEventW manual-reset with ResetEvent if it already exists, watcher thread on WaitForMultipleObjects, SIGINT/SIGBREAK handlers in the main thread, SetConsoleCtrlHandler for CLOSE/LOGOFF/SHUTDOWN; request_stop(pid: int) -> bool — OpenEventW(EVENT_MODIFY_STATE) + SetEvent, False if no event exists.

canonical_timezone(name: str) -> str — exact-case membership in a cached zoneinfo.available_timezones() (or 'UTC'), else ZoneInfoNotFoundError; check_timezone_database() -> None — fail fast if ZoneInfo('UTC')/ZoneInfo('Europe/Istanbul') cannot load.
